interlocks.cause: Guard door opened (ZS-3002 / X32 open) or E-stop chain broken (ES-0001 / X0 open)
interlocks.effect: Immediately de-energises HiPot start / HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and turns off HV-on beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)
De-energises HiPot start / HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV-on beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)
Inhibits HiPot start / HV enable (HP-3005 / Y30) and HV-on beacon (HL-3006 / Y31)

steps.entry: Pallet in ST30 (ZS-3001 / X33), guard door closed (ZS-3002 / X32), E-stop healthy (ES-0001 / X0), and no result latched (neither PASS M310 nor FAIL M311)
steps.exit: Tester reports PASS (HP-3003 / X30), tester reports FAIL (HP-3004 / X31), guard door opens (NOT X32), or E-stop chain lost (NOT X0)
steps.name: HV Enable / Testing

steps.entry: Tester reports PASS (HP-3003 / X30 sets M310) or FAIL (HP-3004 / X31 sets M311)
steps.exit: Pallet leaves ST30 (falling edge of ZS-3001 / X33 resets M310 and M311)
steps.name: Result Latched / Done
